name: agent-progress
description: A band above the prompt: turn timer with usual command durations, context meter, CI status after a push, waiting-on-you, workflow progress

watchCi.title: Watch CI after a push
watchCi.description: After git push or gh pr create, show the pushed commit's GitHub checks in the band until they finish (needs gh)

tellClaudeWhenCiFinishes.title: Tell Claude when CI finishes
tellClaudeWhenCiFinishes.description: When watched CI finishes while Claude is idle, send Claude the result so it can carry on

notifications.title: macOS notifications
notifications.description: Notify when Claude has waited 30s for your answer and when watched CI finishes

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Play a macOS system sound when Claude waits for you and when watched CI finishes

contextWarnTokens.title: Context amber at (tokens)
contextWarnTokens.description: The context meter turns amber above this many tokens (or at 70% of the window)

contextBadTokens.title: Context red at (tokens)
contextBadTokens.description: The context meter turns red and suggests /compact above this many tokens (or at 85% of the window)

paletteFile.title: Palette file
paletteFile.description: A JSON file overriding the band's colours (see the README); ~ is your home folder. Missing is fine.
